comment: The staging script's own stderr lines (packaging/linux/stage.sh; v1.1 WS-15 section 1). Each exit of the script's own prints exactly one 'asb-stage: <line>'. tst_StageScript::catalogueMatchesScript checks this list against the script both ways; the systemd suite's bootstrap_* cases assert the exact line. Placeholders: <dir>, <plen>, <rlen>, <rc>.

lines.line: <dir> is not a directory only root can write
the staging root is not a root-only directory
the program does not match its digest
the staged program could not be executed (<rc>)
